nom: Vacation Orange Gelée Spray Oil SPF 30

segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes very fair skin that avoided sunburn after long sun exposure, but no reviewer reports irritation or breakouts tied to sensitivity.
segments.dry: One reviewer calls the oil hydrating and moisturizing on otherwise dry, winter-pale skin, with no sunburn after repeated daily use.
segments.mature: A long-time user in her decades of use and one describing skin conditioning report the product fits an established tanning-oil routine without adverse effects.
segments.normal: Most reviewers give no explicit skin type, describing general effects (glow, tan, moisture) consistent with normal, unspecified skin.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the oil leaves skin moisturized, hydrated and not sticky after beach or pool use; one who dislikes sunscreen generally still found it non-drying.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report no sunburn even after full-day or week-long sun exposure, including one with fair skin; one reviewer says they burned slightly on first use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers call it very oily, slow to absorb, and transfer-prone onto clothes, chairs and hands; others explicitly say the spray version feels less greasy than the original gel and absorbs without an oily residue.

extraits.texte: Very oily and must rub in extremely thoroughly. It also makes you oily for a long time and will get oil on everything you touch. The spray bottle also gets very slippery/oily. I generally like spray for its ease and ability to apply without getting my hands all oily, but this is not that!

extraits.titre: Slimy oil that gets on everything
extraits.texte: I don't really like sunscreen to begin with, and I hated this one. I bought it because people were saying how great it smells. I didn't find the scent to be great, but I didn't dislike it either. The people around me said it smelled alright, but kind of strange. The part I truly hated was that this spray made me feel so greasy! I couldn't get it to absorb. It's been hours since I applied it, and I still feel gross and greasy. Plus, it went everywhere. It got on my face, on my chair, in my car, on my desk while typing this. It's just everywhere!

Reminds me of the old Bain de Soleil gelee of the 1960's, now gone. It smells okay with just a trace of chemical odor. A little goes a long way and it beads up on skin when in the pool so you know it's there. I burned a little on first use however.

Bought this, the invisible face gel and the oil right before my Florida vacation. My pale skin hadn't been sun exposed in 6 long winter months and applied Orange Gelee 2x a day while being exposed to the sun 7 long hot days and it did its job. No sunburn and bonus my skin felt great. A little goes a long way as well

extraits.titre: I Didn't Think Orange Gelee Could Get Any Better!
extraits.texte: Orange Gelee Spray is a game changer! It's everything I love about Orange Gelee (THE SCENT) without the oil feeling. It goes on so easily and smell amazing. I think the scent of the spray lingers for a longer period of time than the original in a tube. I love this stuff!!!!!!
Great purchase! Was in Palm Springs for a long weekend and didn't get burned whatsoever. I am very fair and this has long lasting power

I haven't been stung by a bee since I was 10 years old, so it's been over 20 years. I got stung twice within a 2 hour period my first time using this sunscreen. The bergamot scent is a known to attract bees and other pollinators and I should've known better than to wear a sunscreen like this. I've had no issues with the regular vacation sunscreens so I'll just stick to those!
